purpose: Independent training-scene diagnostic of absolute arm-target drift before base arrival
label_source: P6 Arm.__init__/update uses the reset arm home in approach_base. Verify its absolute physical targets throughout the corresponding original P6 demonstrations. Use only this target on approach_base feedback states with a valid complete 20 ms interval.
actor: Same architecture, sensor-only deployable inputs, fixed input scalers and common visual/text encoders. Restore the complete parent actor and AdamW state.
feedback_sampling: Half uniform over all eligible states, half uniform over first five seconds to include drift onset.
auxiliary_loss: 0.5 times mean SmoothL1(beta=0.5) of six normalized arm errors, scaled by their frozen common parent residual standard deviations. Original balanced four-group BC on the 17 common training sources has coefficient 1.
